sig: [[["A", "Hi, team. I want to give you a quick overview of version 3.0 of our mobile banking app, which goes live next Tuesday."], ["A", "The biggest change is the new home screen. Users can now see all their accounts and recent transactions in one place."], ["A", "We've also added fingerprint and face login, which our customers have been asking for since last year."], ["A", "Another new feature is instant transfers between our bank and five partner banks."], ["A", "Those transfers used to take up to two business days, so this is a big deal."], ["A", "On top of that, the app now supports dark mode and loads about thirty percent faster."], ["A", "Since you're the ones who'll be answering customers' questions, it's important that you understand these changes."], ["A", "We'll run a short training session on Monday afternoon, and I'll share a one-page summary right after this meeting."], ["A", "If customers report any bugs, please log them in the support system with screenshots, and tag them 'version three'."], ["A", "The development team will be monitoring those reports closely during the first week."], ["A", "Okay, let's take a look at a quick demo."]], {"A": "M-US"}]
